---
indicator_code: "CNC-001"
indicator_name: "Cancer Registry"
definition: |
  Tracks the **unique number of cancer patients** registered in the cancer treatment
  programme, their **demographic and clinical characteristics**, and their
  **distribution across facilities and counties**. The indicator distinguishes between
  **all patients** (cumulative within a rolling 3-month window) and **new patients**
  appearing in the cancer treatment programme for the first time.
  Patient identity is established via the **Client Registry (CR) Number** to ensure
  deduplication across facilities.
numerator: |
  - **Unique cancer patients** — distinct CR Numbers with at least one record under
    intervention code **SHA-06 (21–33)** in the reference period.
  - **New cancer patients** — CR Numbers appearing in cancer treatment
    for the **first time ever** in the reference period.
denominator: |
  Not applicable
unit_of_measure: |
  - **Count** — unique patients (deduplicated by CR Number)
data_source: |
  - **Client Registry (CR)** — patient identity, demographics, and deduplication
  - **ERP Claims Module** — treatment records and intervention codes
  - **Intervention filter:** `SHA-06 (21–33)` — Hemato-Oncology Treatment
frequency: |
  - **Summary cards** — rolling 3-month window and current month
  - **Trend charts** — monthly aggregation
disaggregation: |
  - Cancer type
  - County
  - Facility Level (Level 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / National Referral)
  - Facility
  - Patient cohort (All patients / New patients)
sdg_who_ref: |
  - **SDG 3.4** — Reduce premature mortality from non-communicable diseases
    (including cancer) by one-third by 2030.
  - **SDG 3.8** — Achieve universal health coverage, ensuring access to essential
    medicines and vaccines.
notes_caveats: |
  - **Deduplication** is performed at the CR Number level — a patient registered at
    multiple facilities in the same period is counted once.
  - **New patient** status is determined from the **entire historical record**, not
    just the current period. A patient is "new" only if they have never appeared in
    cancer treatment before.
  - The intervention scope is limited to **SHA-06 (21–33) Hemato-Oncology Treatment**.
    Other cancer-related interventions outside this code range are excluded.
  - County-level figures reflect the **facility location**, not the patient's
    county of residence.
---
